quote.text: My finances are scattered across too many apps

promise.text: How to organize your finances when everything is scattered

lines.text: Bank apps, statements, a notes file and a lot in your head: a ten minute starting page you can fill in from memory, with the gaps marked.

head.text: List where your money information lives: bank apps, a statements folder, notes, a spreadsheet, a drawer, your head.

body.text: Don't open any of them yet.

head.text: Fill in the six areas from memory.

body.text: Write a question mark next to anything you'd be guessing.

head.text: Circle the number you most want: either what's free to spend, or when a debt ends.

body.text: That decides which question mark you chase first.
A good first one is a bill with no due date, since a missed date is what costs a fee.

head.text: Pick a day to look at the page again: weekly if you're catching up, monthly once things are steady.

body.text: Put it in your calendar, with the page's location.

line.text: One place holding accounts, income, bills, subscriptions, transactions, debt and savings, with a single figure for what is actually available.
